title: A sharp resonance: Q = 200
caption: A resonator at 1000 Hz with half-power bandwidth 5 Hz has Q = f₀/Δf = 200 and ζ = 1/(2Q) = 0.0025. The response peaks at 200 times the static value, and falls to 141.4 (the half-power level, 1/√2 of the peak) at f₀ ± 2.5 Hz, which is r = 0.9975 and 1.0025.
alt: A very narrow tall resonance peak of height 200 at a frequency ratio of 1, with a dashed line at the half-power level 141 crossing the curve at 0.9975 and 1.0025.
description: Amplitude response against r = f/f₀ with ζ = 0.0025.
Half-power level 141.4; the curve crosses it at r ≈ 0.9975 and 1.0025, a bandwidth of 5 Hz on 1000 Hz.
